events.address: North Esplanade by The Rink, Rockefeller Center, 30 Rockefeller Plaza, New York, NY 10112
events.what_it_is: A NYFW beauty activation for Sally Hansen's Miracle Gel Bold Glam collection with nail touch-ups, product play and photo moments at Rockefeller Center.
events.what_is_free: Public access to the activation and advertised nail touch-ups is free. No purchase requirement is stated in the verified event sources.
events.caveats: Rockefeller Center's official NYFW page confirms the activation, Sunday hours and location. Average Socialite independently describes it as open to the public. Services remain subject to normal event capacity and on-site availability.
events.practical_notes: Sunday, September 13 from 10 AM–6 PM at the North Esplanade by The Rink. No RSVP or approval requirement is published.

events.what_it_is: A NYFW Calzedonia pop-up with a hair and makeup refresh station, photo booth, legwear shopping, personalization, coffee and branded giveaways.
events.what_is_free: Public access, complimentary coffee, branded stickers, hair touch-ups and a photo booth are advertised. Embroidery is free with purchase of the specified knee-highs; merchandise itself is not free.
events.caveats: Multiple current event sources agree on the date, hours, address and public access. Free embroidery requires purchase of the specified 20 Denier Hosiery Knee Highs; other promotional items and services are subject to on-site availability.
events.practical_notes: Sunday, September 13 from 12–5 PM at 188 Lafayette Street. No advance RSVP or approval requirement is published in the verified sources.

events.address: Chelsea Triangle, 14th St & 9th Ave, New York, NY 10014
events.what_it_is: A one-day NYFW fragrance-and-coffee activation for NEST NEW YORK's Cardamom Latte Eau de Parfum, pairing fragrance discovery with complimentary Cardamom Lattes.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary Cardamom Lattes and fragrance sampling are advertised while supplies last. No purchase requirement is stated.
events.caveats: Two current sources agree on the September 14 start time, Chelsea Triangle location, complimentary latte offer and fragrance sampling. The promotional items are explicitly while supplies last. No RSVP or approval requirement is established.
events.practical_notes: Monday, September 14 from 10 AM–9 PM, or while supplies last, at Chelsea Triangle in the Meatpacking District.
